title: Kervaire detection at the prime three
exact_target: Which members $b_j$ of the standard prime-three Kervaire-detection family survive to stable sphere homotopy, and which have additive-order-three representatives? The proposed answer is precisely $j=0,2,3$, in stems 10,106,322.
